task_completion_reasoning: The assistant correctly provided the order details and shipping address when requested, and the user explicitly confirmed they had no more questions afterward.

criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user later asked, "can you remind me what shipping address you have on that Galaxy Watch order?", the bot explicitly replied with "The shipping address on your Galaxy Watch order is: Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich", providing the address again.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: At no point in the conversation does the bot say or imply that it has lost access to prior data or tools it had just used.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For the follow-up about the Galaxy Watch shipping address, the bot only provided the address and did not re-list all order details or any other orders.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: Once the user identified the "Galaxy Watch" order, the bot never asked again which order was being discussed or for any already-provided identifying information.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: For each concrete request (status, full details, shipping address) the assistant gave specific, accurate information, though it added an irrelevant remark about replacing a card that was not helpful.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no user pushbacks or corrections indicating misunderstanding; all answers were accepted without disfluency signals.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant generally tracked the order context correctly, but introduced an incoherent turn about 'replacing your card' that did not match anything the user had said.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was consistently polite, concise, and natural, suitable for a customer support interaction.
